title: Krasner neighbourhoods over henselian fields of arbitrary valuation rank
statement: Let $F$ be a field with a nontrivial valuation and henselian valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let $N/F$ be a finite Galois extension: finite, separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and normal, meaning that every minimal polynomial of an element of $N$ over $F$ splits in $N[T]$. Fix a valuation $w$ of $N$ prolonging that of $F$, with values in a totally ordered abelian group, written additively. For $\alpha,\beta\in N$, suppose that $w(\alpha-\beta)>w(\alpha-\sigma(\alpha))$ for every $\sigma\in\operatorname{Aut}_F(N)$ with $\sigma(\alpha)\ne\alpha$. Then $\alpha\in F(\beta)$, where $F(\beta)$ is the smallest subfield containing $F$ and $\beta$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Thus there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $\alpha$ in $N$ such that every $\beta\in U$ satisfies $\alpha\in F(\beta)$. When $\alpha\in F$ the condition is empty and one may take $U=N$. No completeness or rank restriction is imposed.
